description: Assign a scene to a canonical chapter through the explicit structure workflow. Writes canonical SQLite chapter linkage first, then mirrors chapter_id plus compatibility chapter/chapter_title fields to the scene sidecar and index. Pass chapter_id=null to clear an explicit chapter link on an unchaptered scene. Use list_chapters first to choose a valid canonical chapter_id.

chapter_id.description: Canonical chapter identifier. Use list_chapters to find valid values. Pass null to clear an explicit chapter link on an unchaptered scene.

name: assign_scene_to_chapter
